definitions.explanation: The act of getting off or stepping out of a vehicle such as a bus, train, taxi, or car.

examples.japanese: {降車|こうしゃ}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: To press the stop button (on a bus).

examples.japanese: {降車|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch your step when getting off.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{降車|こうしゃ}⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The taxi drop-off point is designated in front of the building's main entrance.

notes:
Composed of {降|こう} (descend, get off) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). A formal term commonly seen on signs, in announcements, and in written instructions for public transportation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降車|こうしゃ}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧ (stop button on a bus)
- {降車|こうしゃ}⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧ (drop-off point, alighting position)
- {降車|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧ (when alighting)
- {降車|こうしゃ}{駅|えき} (station where one gets off)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ — getting on a vehicle, boarding (the antonym)
- ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧ — getting off (a train or bus); very close synonym, slightly more common in everyday use
- ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ — to get off, to descend (the everyday verb form)

USAGE:
{降車|こうしゃ} and ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧ are near-synonyms, but {降車|こうしゃ} is more commonly paired with cars and buses ({降車|こうしゃ}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧), while ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧ is more often used for trains (⟦{途中|とちゅう}{下車|げしゃ}→途中下車：27112_tochuugesha⟧ — getting off partway through a journey).
